compounding_issues: All 5 sessions failed at step 0 with 'Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed' — the documented claude_cli credential-clearing failure mode — so zero code was produced in any session
Each story commit is an empty shell: the entire diff from seed to HEAD is 6 identical 3-line .instrument/session_*.jsonl marker files recording the auth failure (identical md5), never any app code
The runner committed 'successful' story commits (greenfield/feature_addition/integration/refactor/cross_cutting) for sessions that did no work, silently masking the failure as completed story history

The documented remediation (restore ~/.claude/backups/.credentials.good.json) was never applied between sessions — all 5 ran against the same broken credential state instead of halting after session 1
key_decisions: Backend choice of claude_cli for the story, which carried the OAuth credential fragility that doomed the run
Seeding a Tier 2 Flask auth API (app.py, 260 lines) as the greenfield baseline — a reasonable seed, but moot since no session ever built on it
Committing per-session .instrument markers as story commits even when the underlying session produced zero tokens — the pipeline continued the 5-session arc without any work-product verification
Failing to abort the campaign after the first identical auth failure, propagating the dead session through all five planned phases
story_review.trajectory_description: The quality arc is flat at zero: all five sessions are byte-identical authentication failures (0 input tokens, 0 output tokens, $0.00 cost, same error string), and the final worktree contains only the untouched 260-line seed. There is no improvement, degradation, or accumulation because nothing was ever built — the narrative labels (greenfield, feature_addition, integration, refactor, cross_cutting) describe an intended plan that was never executed. The only thing that compounds across the sequence is the unremediated credential failure, re-recorded five times.
story_review.summary: This story is a fully failed run — every session died on an unremediated Claude OAuth credential expiration before producing any code, yielding five empty commit shells around an untouched seed.
